newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian 1996 Novorossiisk oil exports up 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russian 1996 Novorossiisk oil exports up 40 pct.

text.p: Russia's Black Sea oil port of Novorossiisk boosted the amount of crude oil and oil products it handled in 1996 to 43.8 million tonnes, up over 40 percent from 30.7 million in 1995, a Transport Ministry spokesman said.
It handled a total of 52.5 million tonnes of all types of goods in 1996 compared with 38.5 million tonnes in 1995, he said on Wednesday.
Novorossiisk handled 8.7 million tonnes of dry cargo in 1996, up from 7.8 million in 1995.
New handling facilities at the port partly explained the increases, he said.

The port's grain terminal will be able to handle up to one million tonnes of grain annually once upgrades to existing facilities are completed. There are also plans to expand the port's crude oil and oil products facilities.
Novorossiisk is the main Russian oil export terminal.
